title: Uninstall, machine by machine (no script yet)

steps.title: Pi
steps.note: Then remove /home/pi/ccremote-harness, /home/pi/ccremote-web, the two units, and the two ingress rules in /etc/cloudflared/config.yml.

steps.title: PC
steps.note: Remove ~/.config/systemd/user/ccremote-pc.service and ~/.config/ccremote/pc.env. The code is the repo itself.

steps.title: Registries
steps.note: Thread history lives in the SQLite files on each machine. Export what you want to keep first.
